newsitem.title: UK: UK govt denies plan to privatise National Savings.
newsitem.headline: UK govt denies plan to privatise National Savings.

text.p: A government minister on Wednesday dismissed claims that the Conservatives were planning to sell off the National Savings Bank if they win Britain's coming general election.

Economic Secretary to the Treasury Angela Knight said reports that a commitment to a sell-off would appear in the party's election manifesto were "both wrong and unnecessarily alarmist for savers and staff".

Earlier the opposition Labour Party spokesman on the civil service, Derek Foster, said a confidential memorandum discussed by bank executives on Wednesday recommended the sale of the entire enterprise.
National Savings, which manages funds of nearly 60 billion stg, helps to fund the national debt through its offers of savings products to the public. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
